overview.short: Shri Nakoda Ji, also known as Nakoda Parshvanatha Tirth, is an ancient Jain temple pilgrimage center located in Mewanagar near Balotra in Barmer district, Rajasthan. Dating back to the 3rd century, it is famed for its serene marble architecture and the venerated shrine of Nakoda Bhairav.
overview.description: Shri Nakoda Ji, formally known as Nakoda Parshvanatha Tirth, is a world-renowned Jain pilgrimage shrine located near Mewanagar and Balotra in Barmer district, Rajasthan. Dating back to the 3rd century with major historical consecrations, the sacred complex is dedicated to the 23rd Tirthankara, Lord Parshvanatha, and Nakoda Bhairav. Famed for its pristine white marble architecture, intricately sculpted toranas, gilded ceilings, and peaceful desert setting amidst the surrounding hills, Nakoda draws pilgrims from across India seeking spiritual blessings.

topPlaces.name: Balotra Heritage & Textile Town
topPlaces.description: Balotra is a vibrant historical city on the right bank of the Luni River, famed for its centuries-old hand-block printing, vibrant textile craft markets, and authentic Marwari hospitality.

image.alt: Balotra town architecture and historic crossroads

topPlaces.name: Khed Brahmadham & Ranchhodraiji Temple
topPlaces.description: Khed was the historic first capital of the Rathore dynasty in Marwar. It houses the ancient Ranchhodraiji Vishnu Temple and the revered Brahma Temple along the sacred Luni riverbanks.

image.alt: Ancient stone carved sanctum of Khed Temple near Balotra

topPlaces.name: Mewanagar Hill Shrines
topPlaces.description: Mewanagar, the historic town adjoining Nakoda, is cradled by rugged Aravalli ridges featuring panoramic viewpoints, ancient meditation caves, and historic step-paths climbed by generations of ascetics.

image.alt: Scenic view of Mewanagar hill shrines and temples

topPlaces.name: Bithuja Dham & Luni River Basin
topPlaces.description: Bithuja Dham is a venerated pilgrimage sanctuary dedicated to Baba Ramdevji on the banks of the Luni River. Devotees visit for the holy darshan, vast open courtyards, and peaceful riverside atmosphere.

image.alt: Sacred courtyard of Bithuja Dham near the Luni River

topPlaces.name: Jasol Majisa Mata Temple
topPlaces.description: Jasol is the seat of the revered Mata Rani Bhatiyaniji Temple (Majisa), one of Western Rajasthan's most sacred folk shrines. The grand temple features ornate domes, vibrant prayer halls, and spiritual energy.

image.alt: Intricate Rajasthani stone carvings and arched gateway at Jasol

topPlaces.name: Siwana Fort & Aravalli Ridges
topPlaces.description: Perched atop a rugged hill, the historic 10th-century Siwana Fort was built by the Parmara dynasty and served as a legendary stronghold for Rathore heroes during imperial sieges. It offers breathtaking panoramic views.

image.alt: Historic fort battlements and ramparts overlooking desert hills

topPlaces.name: Majivala Rural Oasis
topPlaces.description: Majivala is a peaceful Marwar village known for its traditional agricultural lifestyle, shaded step-wells, and panoramic sand-dune vistas on the fringes of the Thar Desert.

image.alt: Traditional village stepwell and desert architecture at Majivala

topPlaces.name: Tilwara Cattle Fair Grounds
topPlaces.description: Located on the banks of the river Luni, Tilwara is one of Rajasthan's oldest trading grounds, famous for the historic Mallinath Cattle Fair dating back to the 14th century.

image.alt: Open desert plains and landscape near Tilwara by the Luni River

items.note: Balotra is a city situated in the Balotra district within the state of Rajasthan, India. Previously, it was located in the Barmer district of the Indian state of Rajasthan.
Khed Temple, popularly known as the Kher Ranchhoreray Krishna Temple, is located in Khed, Balotra district of Rajasthan.
Khed/Kher is a village in Balotra District, of Rajasthan, India. It is 9 km from Balotra and situated on Baytu-Balotra Road.
Dandali (डंडाली) is a village in Sindhari tehsil in the Balotra district of Rajasthan state, India. It belongs to Jodhpur Division.
Majivala village in Pachpadra tehsil of Balotra district in Rajasthan, India. As of the 2011 India census, the total population of the village is 5882.
Bithuja is a village in Balotra taluk, Balotra district, Rajasthan, India. Bithooja has a total population of 4,870 peoples according to Census 2011.
Mewa Nagar is a village in Pachpadra tehsil of Balotra District, Rajasthan, India.

Nakodaji Tirth is a major Śvetāmbara Jain tirth (pilgrimage site) of Tirthankara Parshwanatha in the Indian state of Rajasthan, located between the villages of Vikrampura and Nakoda in Barmer District. The temple houses the icon of Nakoda Bhairava, a prominent Śvetāmbara guardian deity.

faq.q: What is the best time to visit Nakoda?
faq.a: The best time to visit Nakoda is Oct – Mar. Summers are 28–44°C and winters are 8–25°C.

The nearest airport is Nakoda / nearest airport (30 km) and the nearest railway station is Jodhpur Junction (96 km). Roads are generally good; check seasonal/monsoon conditions before high-altitude or remote stretches.

faq.q: How many days are enough for Nakoda?
faq.a: 3 days are usually enough to cover the top attractions of Nakoda at a relaxed pace.
